adr.title: Staged Generation of Procurement Documents
adr.context: The system must generate an initial document based on a record in the procurement system. It must use the administrator-registered layout appropriate to the document type, replace layout variables with AI-generated content, and produce readable, harmonious text in technical-legal language. These requirements involve distinct transformations that must work together in the final document.
adr.decision: We will generate the document through a sequence of processing stages. The stages will select the appropriate registered layout, replace its variables with AI-generated content, and combine the layout and variable text into a readable, harmonious document in technical-legal language. Each stage will pass its result to the next.
adr.consequences: Separating the transformations will make it easier to adjust one stage without changing the entire generation flow. The stages will also need to remain coordinated: a change to an intermediate result can affect the readability, formatting, or language of the final document.
